{{Short description|Italian statistician (born 1951)}}

'''Adelchi Azzalini''' (born 1951) is an Italian statistician and educator. He is known for research in [[Likelihoodist statistics|likelihood inference]] and multivariate statistics including the development of [[Skew normal distribution|skew normal distributions]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Azzalini |first=Adelchi |date=2005 |title=The Skew-Normal Distribution and Related Multivariate Families |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/4616868 |journal=Scandinavian Journal of Statistics |volume=32 |issue=2 |pages=159–188 |doi=10.1111/j.1467-9469.2005.00426.x |jstor=4616868 |s2cid=119968494 |issn=0303-6898|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Adcock |first1=Chris |last2=Azzalini |first2=Adelchi |date=2020-01-07 |title=A Selective Overview of Skew-Elliptical and Related Distributions and of Their Applications |journal=Symmetry |language=en |volume=12 |issue=1 |pages=118 |doi=10.3390/sym12010118 |bibcode=2020Symm...12..118A |issn=2073-8994 |doi-access=free }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Video: Adelchi Azzalini, "Skew-Symmetric Distributions in 45'" |url=http://www.birs.ca/events/2013/5-day-workshops/13w5146/videos/watch/201305200934-Azzalini.html |access-date=2023-11-27 |website=www.birs.ca}}</ref>

== Education and career ==
Azzalini was born in Milan and received his ''[[laurea]]'' in statistics and economics from the [[University of Padua]] in 1975. He carried out his military service for a year before working as a research assistant at the [[University of Padua]]. In 1978, Azzalini moved to the UK and studied at [[Imperial College London]], where he received his MSc and PhD, both in statistics, in 1979 and 1981, respectively. His PhD supervisor was [[David Cox (statistician)|David Cox]]. Azzalini returned to [[Padua]] to take on a researcher position in 1981 and became a professor at the [[University of Padua]] in 1986 and remained there since.<ref name=CV>{{Cite web |title=[PDF] Curriculum vitae. of Adelchi Azzalini. (as of October 2010) - Free Download PDF |url=https://silo.tips/download/curriculum-vitae-of-adelchi-azzalini-as-of-october-2010 |access-date=2023-04-30 |website=silo.tips |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Montanari |first=Angela |date=2020-10-01 |title=A Conversation with Adelchi Azzalini and Narayanaswamy Balakrishnan |url=https://rivista-statistica.unibo.it/article/view/11589 |journal=Statistica |language=en |volume=80 |pages=131–143 |doi=10.6092/ISSN.1973-2201/11589}}</ref>

Azzalini is a fellow of the [[Royal Statistical Society]],<ref name=CV></ref> a member of the [[Bernoulli Society for Mathematical Statistics and Probability]] and served as the editor of the Bernoulli News in 2000.<ref>{{Cite journal |date=2000 |title=Announcement — Change of Editor of Bernoulli News |url=https://bernoullisociety.org/files/Bernoulli_News_7-1.pdf |journal=Bernoulli News |volume=7 |issue=1}}</ref> In 2011, a workshop was held at the [[Pontifical Catholic University of Chile]] to honor Azzalini's contribution to the development of the skew-normal distribution.<ref>{{Cite web |title=PROBABILISTIC AND INFERENTIAL ASPECTS OF SKEW-SYMMETRIC MODELS: A WORKSHOP IN HONOUR OF ADELCHI AZZALINI´S 60TH BIRTHDAY |url=https://www.mat.uc.cl/noticias/2011-03-18/probabilistic-and-inferential-aspects-of-skew-symmetric-models-a-workshop-in-honour-of-adelchi-azzalinis-60th-birthday.html|language=es}}</ref>
